test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

We are all / familiar to a / use of fingerprints / in solving crimes.
solution:
The correct answer is** "familiar to a".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence is **" we are all familiar with the use of fingerprints in solving crimes."**
 
• **'With the' **means in the company of something or having something.
 
• **Examples**- *I am familiar with all the tricks of maths.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To -** used to indicate destination or direction.

 
 
• **Example -** *She is going to a party.*
 
 
 
• **We are all** - It is correct as** 'we'** is plural and along with plural words **'are'** is used.
 
 
• **Example - ***We are going to a party.*
 
 
 
• **In -** used to show inside.
 
 
• **Example - ***She lay in bed.*
